From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Finex discovery — next steps & demo scheduling

Hi Amit / Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and very helpful context on your fraud-detection and model-ops constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You run real-time scoring for transaction risk (sub-100ms SLO) and are evaluating options to reduce per-token inference costs while keeping latency <= 120ms for peak traffic. Current stack: internal model with CPU-based microservices; evaluating GPU inference with model quantization.
- What we can help with: Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency, automatic KV/prefix caching to reduce calls to the model, and Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization profiles.

Next actions:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (45 min) — walkthrough of Dedicated runtime, latency profiling, and a short live demo on a sample workload.
2) Share a Mutual Action Plan for procurement & POC scope.

I pulled together short discovery notes and a draft mutual action plan (attached). Can you confirm availability for a 45-min demo the week of July 6? I have the following slots open (PT):
- Tue Jul 7 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jul 8 11:00–11:45
- Thu Jul 9 14:00–14:45

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I'll coordinate. To make scheduling tighter this time, can you reply with a firm "Yes — pick X slot" (or accept the calendar invite when I send it) rather than a tentative? We saw a couple of last-minute conflicts in similar POC timelines and want to lock cadence early.

Thanks — I'll hold the slots for now and send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments:
- discovery_notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 60KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole
